wave.name: Marisol
wave.title: sky-sailor
wave.blurb: a scatter of bright islands and shallow seas
wave.about: Calm under pressure. Trusts the tide to turn.
wave.challenge: The Isles are closed to strangers. If you want my waters, earn them.
wave.join: The Citadel, fallen? Those six sailed straight through my waters to get there. I'm coming. You'll want a navigator.

nemesis.name: Wavemaster Sable
nemesis.taunt: {ally}. Still chasing the horizon? You never could beat me to it.
nemesis.answer: You and me first, {ally}, as it always was. Your friends can wait until one of yours goes under.

flame.name: Kael
flame.title: blacksmith knight
flame.blurb: black slopes under a smoking mountain
flame.about: Proud and direct. Never backs down from a challenge.
flame.challenge: Nobody crosses into my land without a battle. Nobody.
flame.join: ...The Citadel has fallen? And you mean to take it back? Then I'm coming with you.

nemesis.name: Flamemaster Varek
nemesis.taunt: {ally}. Still hammering away at being a hero? I know every move you have.
nemesis.answer: Every trick? Then face me yourself, {ally}, and I'll teach you one more. Your friends can come in when one of yours falls.
nemesis.beaten: Hmph. Go on, then. It won't matter.

root.name: Willow
root.title: ranger
root.blurb: an old forest where the paths close behind you
root.about: Patient and watchful. Slow to trust, hard to shake.
root.challenge: You walk loud for someone in my forest. Stand still, and let's see what you're made of.
root.join: Those six left a blight through half my forest on their way. I'll walk with you.

nemesis.name: Rootmaster Nettle
nemesis.taunt: Little {ally}. The forest can't hide you in here.
nemesis.answer: Yours, is it? Come on, then, little {ally}. Just you. The others can wait until one of yours has wilted.
nemesis.beaten: Go, then. The top of the tower will wither you.

breeze.name: Soren
breeze.title: cliff-runner
breeze.blurb: thin towers of rock above the clouds
breeze.about: Light on his feet and quick to laugh. Hates standing still.
breeze.challenge: Careful! It's a long way down. Nobody takes the high road without getting past me.
breeze.join: Storming the Citadel? That's the best idea I've heard all year. Count me in!

nemesis.name: Breezemaster Corvin
nemesis.taunt: {ally}! Still running? You always were faster. Never stronger.
nemesis.answer: Then stand still for once, {ally}, and face me yourself. Your friends can wait until I've brought one of yours down.
nemesis.beaten: Run along, then. See how far it gets you.

soil.name: Bram
soil.title: stonemason
soil.blurb: a canyon town cut from red rock
soil.about: Slow to move and impossible to push. Says little, means all of it.
soil.challenge: Road's shut. Has been since those six came through. If you want it open, you'll have to move me.
soil.join: Hm. The Citadel. About time somebody went. I'll come.

nemesis.name: Soilmaster Dorn
nemesis.taunt: {ally}. Slow as ever. I'd have opened the gate for you, if you'd asked nicely.
nemesis.answer: No hurry, {ally}. It's you I'll have first. The others can take their turn once one of yours has dropped.
nemesis.beaten: Hm. Pass. You'll find the top less forgiving.

lightning.name: Juno
lightning.title: storm-chaser
lightning.blurb: a high plain where the storms never quite leave
lightning.about: Restless and fearless. Thinks fast and talks faster.
lightning.challenge: Ha! You picked a bad day for a walk, stranger. Let's see if you can keep up with the storm.
lightning.join: The Citadel?! Why didn't you open with that? I'm in!

nemesis.name: Lightningmaster Vesper
nemesis.taunt: {ally}, darling. Still chasing storms? I became one.
nemesis.answer: Oh, I insist, darling. You first, and only you. Somebody has to teach you a lesson. The others may join in once one of yours is down.
nemesis.beaten: Oh, go on up. I do so want to watch.
